title: HB331 (2024 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2024/bills/HB331_.HTM; sha256 0c663fbf33fda8f43af9c7eb78684f06b4a687574b0ce4ce58db8d7df156eab8)
provenance.note: As-filed text (introduced). No passage vote on file. Carried-over bill; same text as the other year.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new): It shall be unlawful for a person to possess a loaded firearm while the person is intoxicated.
SECTION 1 (new): Any person violating this section shall be guilty of a petty misdemeanor.
SECTION 1 (new): A person is intoxicated if the person: (A) Is under the influence of alcohol in an amount sufficient to impair the person's normal mental faculties or ability to operate a firearm in a careful and prudent manner; (B) Has .08 or more grams of alcohol per two hundred ten liters of the person's breath; or (C) Has .08 or more grams of alcohol per one hundred milliliters or cubic centimeters of the person's blood.
